sources.title: Qwen
sources.snippet: We are launching Qwen-Image-3.0, the third-generation foundational image generation model in the Qwen-Image series. If the keyword for Qwen-Image-1. was "Precision", and the keywords for Qwen-Image-2. were "Precision, Variety, Completeness, Beauty, and Authenticity", then the core of Qwen-Image-3. comes down to a single word — "Real" (实).

sources.title: Qwen2.5 - a Qwen Collection - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 language models, including pretrained and instruction-tuned models of 7 sizes, including 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B.

sources.title: Qwen Studio
sources.snippet: Qwen Studio is an official platform from Qwen that empowers both everyday users and developers with unified access to Qwen's series of open-source and proprietary models. It offers comprehensive functionality spanning chatbots, image and video understanding, image generation and editing, document processing, tool utilization, voice and video chat, and artifacts.

sources.title: GitHub - mx4ai/qwen2.5: Qwen2.5 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.

sources.title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Our flagship model, Qwen2.5-72B, further narrows the gap between Qwen and state-of-the-art models like GPT-4 and Claude3.5-sonnet. In particular, Qwen2.5-72B matches or exceeds the performance of Llama-3.1-405B in all metrics except for instruction following.
